apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: Planespotters search improvements: Mode-S hex codes now work too, empty results and unknown registrations show a clean message instead of an error, and the app explains that Planespotters only supports exact registration lookups.
